home-decor.heroTagline: Custom printed tiles, wooden wall art, canvas prints, leatherette goods, printed cabinet doors and glass partition panels — created in-house under one roof.
home-decor.storyP1: In the dialogue between a living space and its inhabitants, interior decor serves as the main atmosphere. Our approach treats every wall tile, wood panel, decorative clock, and printed glass partition as a permanent installation — elevating personal photography and artwork to a refined aesthetic statement.
home-decor.storyP2: By combining high-definition UV printing with direct-to-surface tactile texturing, we create decor pieces — from photo wood blocks and decorative clocks to leatherette wallets, diaries and passport holders — that don’t just fill space; they define the warmth and character of the home.

personalized-gifts.heroTagline: Everyday objects turned into lasting keepsakes with 3D tactile UV printing and precision laser engraving.
personalized-gifts.storyP1: A true gift carries the weight of the moments it celebrates. Our custom gifts collection transforms everyday objects — mobile covers, laptop skins, acrylic photo frames, keychains, and drinkware — into tactile keepsakes with full-colour depth and 3D texture.
personalized-gifts.storyP2: From back-printed acrylic photo blocks and Spotify music plaques to branded pen drives and leatherette coasters, every item is printed and engraved in-house at Saravanampatti, Coimbatore — ensuring swift 24-48 hour turnaround with zero compromise on artisanal detail.

signage-branding.heroTagline: Crafted to leave a lasting impression. Every piece is an intersection of heritage material and modern precision.
signage-branding.storyP1: In the dialogue between a structure and its visitors, signage serves as the primary voice. Our approach treats every marker — from acrylic logo boards and reception signs to acrylic nameplates, desk ID badges, and PVC foam sunboards — as a permanent installation, elevating functional orientation to an aesthetic statement.
signage-branding.storyP2: By blending time-honoured craftsmanship with contemporary laser-precision — including accessibility-compliant Braille and tactile signage — we create artifacts that don’t just point the way; they define the atmosphere of the space they inhabit.
